skill_step: The skill writes the note as `<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<title-slug>.md` in a checkpoints directory, with frontmatter (status: in-progress, branch, timestamp, files_modified) and the sections Working on, Summary, Decisions Made, Remaining Work (each item starting `Open.`) and Notes.

checks.why: one note in checkpoints/, as the request asked
it is about the billing refactor in SCRATCH.md
it records the branch from status.txt
the skill's file name: a YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS timestamp, then the title slug
the skill's frontmatter opens with status: in-progress
the skill's section names in order
each remaining-work item starts with Open.
